day_shape: 94 items: Khamenei funeral logistics dominate Iranian state channels (3,700 schools readied, free Mashhad transit), IDF strikes 3 Hezbollah command centres and demolishes 200m Majdal Zoun tunnel, Pezeshkian cites $6–12bn in frozen assets via MoU, US-Iran Doha technical talks pending, nothing from UK Parliament or OFAC.

threads.label: Khamenei funeral preparations across Iran
threads.summary: Iranian state and IRGC-affiliated Telegram channels detailed logistics for the burial of the 'martyred leader', with the Tehran governor citing arrangements for health, security, housing and transport. IRIB reported over 3,700 schools and centres being readied for mourners, free public transport in Mashhad for a week, and heat-stroke prevention plans.

threads.label: US-Iran MoU implementation and frozen assets
threads.summary: Pezeshkian told state media Iran is set to receive '$6 to $12 billion' in frozen assets following the memorandum of understanding, with US-Iran technical teams due to meet in Doha. Senior negotiator Gharibabadi said no technical working-group sessions are scheduled this week, while a US official told the Jerusalem Post the talks have not been cancelled after Saturday's exchange of strikes.

threads.label: IDF strikes Hezbollah sites in south Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF said it struck three Hezbollah command centres in Nabatieh and Mayfadoun and destroyed a launcher, citing ceasefire violations. Netanyahu and Defence Minister Katz announced demolition of a 200-metre, 25-metre-deep Hezbollah tunnel under Majdal Zoun containing hundreds of weapons and four launch shafts, attributed to Iranian expertise.

threads.label: IDF officer killed, Hezbollah gunman eliminated
threads.summary: The IDF said Captain David Hazutt, 21, a Golani platoon commander from Ashkelon, was killed overnight by a Hezbollah gunman in Deir Siryan. The military said the gunman was located and killed in subsequent searches, and a separate probe found a June 19 tank strike that killed four soldiers was caused by an explosive-laden drone.

threads.label: Israel-Lebanon framework agreement
threads.summary: IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir called the agreement signed with the Lebanese government 'historic and significant', saying military achievements created the conditions for it. The Jerusalem Post carried multiple analyses comparing the new southern Lebanon security zone to the 1980s-90s arrangement and discussing potential disarmament implications for Gaza.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and Iran-Gulf attacks
threads.summary: Defa Press reported Iran's Gharibabadi held the first Iran-Oman joint Hormuz committee meeting in Muscat under the post-war MoU. Iran International reported Iran and the US traded strikes Sunday, with Tehran targeting US military sites in Kuwait and Bahrain and Washington striking facilities near the Strait of Hormuz; IRIB cited a former US congressman claiming Iran now controls the strait.

threads.label: Khamenei judiciary-week message and opposition response
threads.summary: Khamenei's office published the leader's message marking Judiciary Week and the anniversary of Ayatollah Beheshti's killing, calling pursuit of rights violated by 'international criminals' in 1404-1405 a national priority. Crown Prince Reza Pahlavi called for a 'Global Week of Action for a Free Iran' to coincide with the regime's planned burial of Khamenei, per the Jerusalem Post.

events.title: The IDF demolished a large Hezbollah underground facility in the southern Lebanon village of Majdal Zoun a short while ago, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Defense Minister Israel Katz announce.
